proposition: Muḥammad Ṣūfī b. Tarkhān, a commander in Shāhrukh's army, asked (through the Yazdī collection) for a volume of Ibn Turka's works in Persian and described them as directed toward the ūlū l-aydī wa-l-abṣār; the request shows demand for his writings among the military elite.

mediation.who: Muḥammad Ṣūfī b. Tarkhān, presumably to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī
mediation.note: An admirer's request; not written by Ibn Turka.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: MK says the letter was 'presumably' to Yazdī; 'shows demand' is this claim's gloss on MK's summary
